items.title: Another really strong game for Yang Hansen, including the game-winner as China beat Lebanon.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Another really strong game for Yang Hansen, including the game-winner as China beat Lebanon.

Yang had 19 points on 8-for-9 shooting, made a three, 9 rebounds, 1 block.

Very good qualifying window for Yang before he heads to Portland for Year 2 in the NBA.
